question: Why does the native Guide Email folder omit active NPC letters and available Guide/Nano invitations?
findings: cnEmailSystemManager.AddEmail(MissionElement) admits active task letters only for start message types 4 or 6; their email mode is 1.
ReceiveRefreshEmailInfo adds active letters first, then the first available Guide and Nano invitation in table order, with email mode 2. Active or completed mission owners are excluded.
Panel_EmailList mode 1 uses the start-message sender and current start-message string; mode 2 uses the selected mentor sender and mentor-email string column.
The native implementation previously admitted only active task IDs with mentor copy, and incorrectly used the task type as email mode.
The native refresh also reset the selected row every frame even when the projected letters were identical.
nativeChanges: Restore active NPC letter admission and available invitations using authoritative mission availability.
Use the same invitation selection for login mail/no-mail notification.
Bind NPC sender, mission title and letter body to existing EN/RU semantic keys.
Preserve selected mail when the projection is unchanged.
limits: No Unity binary or native asset payload was changed. Existing native geometry and fonts are reused.
Live authenticated shard exchange was not exercised; the mail projection is client-owned and was tested against production tables and explicit in-memory progression.

fixtureNotes: The production network error handler closes modal windows when the offline bridge rejects gameplay requests before shard entry.
